indicator.aow: AOW02: Fragile and Conflict-affected Food Systems
indicator.description: AW2P3: Fragility and Conflict Sensitivity Hub- Design and roll out a Fragility and Conflict Sensitivity Toolkit that integrates climate-security analytics into CGIAR programs. The toolkit will guide scientists and partners in assessing, mitigating, and monitoring conflict risks, embedding peace-positive practices across food, land, and water research portfolios in fragile and conflict-affected contexts.

results.title: Fragility and Conflict Sensitivity Hub established as strategic mechanism
results.description: The Fragility and Conflict Sensitivity Hub has been established since January 2026 as a strategic mechanism to support implementation of Area of Work 2 across fragile and conflict-affected contexts. The Hub strengthens evidence on fragility and conflict, supports design of conflict-sensitive research and interventions, and fosters integration of climate-security analytics into CGIAR programs. Directly contributes to three High-Level Outcomes.

results.title: Conflict Sensitivity Repository framework developed with 11 CGIAR centers
results.description: A Conflict Sensitivity Repository has been developed with resource extraction completed for 11 CGIAR centers and stored in a completed assessment and taxonomizing framework. Five centre consultations have been conducted to validate extracted resources, identify new internal resources, and assess extent of informal conflict sensitivity practices. Data collected will inform creation of a formal repository accessible across CGIAR.
